jakubwilkuu: Benedikt Jakubwilkuu came up the line in the rain with a stub of a pencil and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
The field cooks took Benedikt Jakubwilkuu in on a wet morning in S-F15. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.
Benedikt Jakubwilkuu came off watch unable to remember whether the last hour had been long or short. He remembered every movement in one patch of wire.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F15 and grazed Benedikt Jakubwilkuu's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Tobias Hellcat of the Hegemony (@hellcat34106). Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Benedikt Jakubwilkuu could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Benedikt Jakubwilkuu no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Benedikt Jakubwilkuu (Concord) and Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges (Hegemony) ended up in the same shell hole at the Chalk Pits. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
A man asked Benedikt Jakubwilkuu to describe Esterhaus without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
kil.lakam20: Tobias Lakam walked into S-F21 on Day 5 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Tobias Lakam tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
